Definition: Foliation index of the cerebellum calculated as pial surface area divided by external cerebellar surface area (PSA/ESA), both estimated from histological sections; quantifies the degree of cerebellar cortical folding (Ashwell 2020). A cerebellar area ratio from sections: not interchangeable with Heuer 2023 section measures, the Zilles gyrification index, or the Mota & Herculano-Houzel folding index.
Note: Wired 2026-11 (Ashwell extension of the cerebellar folding merge); see cerebellar_folding_compiled.R.

Definition: Total pial surface area of the cerebellum in square millimetres, including all sulci and fissures whether facing subarachnoid space or the fourth ventricle (Ashwell 2020); the numerator of the cerebellar foliation index.
Note: Wired 2026-11 (Ashwell extension of the cerebellar folding merge); see cerebellar_folding_compiled.R.

Definition: External surface area of the cerebellum in square millimetres, defined as the multi-sided convex polygon enclosing the cerebellar surface in contact with subarachnoid space or fourth ventricle lumen (Ashwell 2020); the denominator of the cerebellar foliation index.
Note: Wired 2026-11 (Ashwell extension of the cerebellar folding merge); see cerebellar_folding_compiled.R.
